d: Terrace in the Grimani palace in Venice. Night party. Some Masks cross the theater from a distance. From the two sides of the terrace you can see the splendidly illuminated palace: at the bottom of the canal of Giudecca, on which you can see passing at intervals in the darkness some gondolas; in distant Venice at the moonlight. At the dawn of the curtain the music expresses the feast, which takes place in the palace. From when and when they come Lords and Dames magnificently dressed with their mask in the hand. Some other Masks are entertaining talking to each other. They come on stage happily Gubetta, Gazella, Orsini, Petrucci, Vitellozzo and Liverotto. So Gennaro who, as a tired man, rests over a seat secluded by others.
A gondola passes through; a masked lady comes out of it. Lucrezia Borgia: she looks inside. She sees Gennaro asleep, and approaches him contemplating him with pleasure and respect. Gubetta returns.
Lucrezia and Gennaro asleep. As Lucrezia approaches Gennaro she doesn't notice two masked men passing from the bottom, and they stop aside.

A square of Ferrara. On one side with a veron, under which a coat of arms of marble, where it is written with visible characters of golden copper: "BORGIA" . On the other a small house with the door on the road, whose windows are illuminated inside. Night. Duke Alfonso and Rustighello covered by long mantle.
Gennaro, Orsini, Liverotto, Petrucci, Gazella, Vitellozzo. They all come out of the house of Gennaro. He alone is thoughtful. Gubetta shows himself apart.
Astolfo and Rustighello both walking, then Scherani.

Room in the ducal palace. Large door at the bottom. Straight an exit closed by glazed. Left an other secret door. Coffee table in the middle covered with velvet. Alfonso, then Rustighello, then a Exit.
Lucrezia and said, go to Gennaro among the Guards.
Gennaro returns to the Custodians. Indi Rustighello.
Small courtyard that puts at the house of Gennaro. A window of the house is illuminated. It is night. A Scherani's dragon enters spying.
Orsini, indi Gennaro, Scherani hidden. Orsini knocks at the door of Gennaro. He opens and goes out.
The Scherani come back, Rustighello keeps them.

Room in the Negroni Palace illuminated and decorated for festive banquet. They are sitting at a table richly set up Princess Negroni with many beautifully dressed Dames, Orsini, Liverotto, Vitellozzo, Gazella, Petrucci, each with a lady at his side. On one side of the table is Gubetta. On the other is Gennaro.
Gubetta, Orsino, Liverotto, Vitellozzo, Gazella, Petrucci and Gennaro.
The door opens from the bottom and Lucrezia Borgia presents herself with armed people.
The doors of the bottom open and Alfonso comes out with Rustighello. Guards.
